title: Japan 2-Year JGB auction (No.491 inferred) — the month-matched control for the 2026-10-29 BoJ-day-one print
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) — its table row reads 'Nov. 30, 2026 | 2-year'. All of the announcement, result and Non-Price-Competitive-II cells are the plain string 'Detail' with no href, so nothing about this auction has been published; at MOF's D-7 lead (41 of its last 44 2-Year announcements) terms publish about 2026-11-23. The '(No.491)' is an INFERENCE, not MOF's print — the calendar prints an issue number only once announced. Reproduced across MOF's full published English calendar set 2301e-2611e (47 x HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09): 44 held 2-Year auctions run No.445 (2023-01-31) to No.488 (2026-08-28) with zero gaps, one per calendar month, and the Sep. 30 / Oct. 29 / Nov. 30 rows follow unnumbered. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of jgb-2y-auction-2026-10-29
notes: PROPOSED because it is the control arm of the proposer's own headline test, not because it completes a calendar. The proposer's finding is that a 2-Year auction clearing on day one of a BoJ MPM prints thinner cover than its month-matched peers (n = 3, exact permutation p = 0.029, filed MIXED because it does not survive multiplicity). The 2026-10-29 print is the treatment observation. Scoring it alone cannot separate 'day one of an MPM' from 'the late-2026 rates regime', because a 2-Year auction into a 2Y that has run +19bp in a fortnight may print thin for reasons that have nothing to do with the BoJ calendar. THIS auction is the matched control: the very next 2-Year print, same regime, same offering size, and NOT inside an MPM — BoJ's December 2026 meeting is Dec. 17-18 (boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09), so 2026-11-30 sits 17 days clear of it. A treatment that reads thin and a control that reads normal is evidence; both reading thin is a regime and kills the hypothesis. Secondary value: it is the second consecutive scoring point on the offering-size call. MOF has moved the 2-Year offering three times in the 44 published prints — Y2,900bn (2023-01 to 2024-02, 14 prints), Y2,600bn (2024-03 to 2025-08, 18), Y2,700bn (2025-09 to 2025-11, 3), Y2,800bn (2025-12 to 2026-08, 9) — twice in the last 14 months and every move upward, so the family's inherited 'Y2,800bn in 8 of 8' is a within-regime reading rather than a constant. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
